rules.logic: ABIOC(ITDR-016 Impossible-Travel Sign-In Deviation on Target Identity) AND ABIOC(ITDR-016 Anomalous Privilege Grant and MFA Reset on the Compromised Identity) on the same actor_effective_username within a 30-minute window -> raises a single account-takeover incident. This incident is the trigger condition bound to the XSOAR/XSIAM identity-containment playbook (auto-disable + session revoke).
rules.name: ITDR-016 Account-Takeover Compromise Fusion — Auto-Disable Playbook Trigger

rules.logic: CORRELATION(ITDR-016 Account-Takeover Compromise Fusion — Auto-Disable Playbook Trigger) AND okta_sso eventType = "user.lifecycle.suspend" AND okta_sso eventType = "user.session.clear", all resolving to the same actor_effective_username -> confirms the compromise->remediation chain is ONE incident. The rule asserts the auto-disable is (a) real — both suspend and session.clear fired; (b) targeted — the remediation actor_effective_username matches the compromised identity, not a bystander; and (c) timely — remediation_ts minus the correlation alert_ts is within the response SLA (default 300s). This terminal assertion is the Remediation Success Rate / SLA-compliance KPI: proof the closed loop closed.
rules.name: ITDR-016 Closed-Loop Auto-Disable SLA Validation — F5 Response KPI
